name: What are the signs that my water heater needs to be flushed?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that my water heater needs to be flushed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate your water heater may need flushing. These include strange noises like popping or rumbling coming from the tank, which are often caused by sediment heating and expanding. A decrease in hot water availability or fluctuating water temperatures can also point to sediment interference. Additionally, if you notice rusty or discolored hot water, it could be a sign of internal corrosion exacerbated by sediment buildup. Addressing these signs promptly can prevent more significant damage and costly repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include popping or rumbling noises, reduced hot water, fluctuating temperatures, or rusty water. These indicate sediment buildup and a need for flushing.
